events.text: A2/A3/A4, does anyone know the safe door for gate 1? I’ll inspect now; please share any gate intel and coordinate so we avoid duplicate risk.

I found a SERVICE TUNNEL leading directly to Bay E. Access code: 8861. I’m using it now to deliver the insulin; follow if needed.
